datum: Pavement under the left jamb of A2–A5, Y=0 south wall. Pipe axis intersects a different facade.
coordinate_system: X eastward along Hunan Road, Y north into the house, Z above street. Authoring origin at ground under western jamb of the first (A) window on the straight south wall; corner pipe offsets are independently measured.

lane_wall.pipe_projection_method: Wall anchor at outer curved jamb. Iron stands proud of wall by its radius; wall projections alone provide a horizontal offset estimate.

east_return.interpretation: The independent four-station roof check follows the measured 16-degree E-bank turn. Adopt the four-station corner X 13.36, Y 1.17, Z 18.20 m. Two-station east-only assessment assumed parallel windows and is superseded. Three narrow east openings are separately visible. Trees, court wall and neighbouring red roof obscure the lower and rear parts.
